offer.text: The kiln's cold for want of clay. Dig me 16 lumps from the riverbank and we'll fire some brick.

accept.text: Wet work, but the kiln pays it back in warmth. Thank you.

decline.text: No clay, no brick, no business.

in_progress.text: How much clay have you dug?

ready.text: Sixteen good lumps! The kiln roars to life.

complete.text: Honest, muddy work. The village builds on it.
